# Pinterest

> > Pinterest is a visual discovery and inspiration platform where users create and share collections of ideas through Pins and Boards, with tools for creators, businesses, and developers.

Pinterest offers a comprehensive ecosystem including content discovery, creator tools, analytics, advertising solutions, and developer APIs. The platform enables users to explore trending ideas across categories like fashion, home decor, recipes, and DIY projects while providing business tools for marketers and technical integration options through the Pinterest API and Conversions API.

## Key Topics

- Pins
- Boards
- Pinterest Analytics
- Pinterest Ads
- Pinterest API
- Pinterest Conversions API
- Creator Hub
- Pinterest Tag
- Ideas Discovery

- Business Account

- Pinterest Privacy Policy

## Discover & Explore

- [Explore the best of Pinterest](https://za.pinterest.com/ideas/): Ideas discovery page for recipes, home, style, and DIY inspiration
- [Explore the best of Pinterest](https://au.pinterest.com/ideas/): Browse curated content categories and trending visual inspiration
- [Today's Top Trends on Pinterest](https://ie.pinterest.com/today/): Handpicked trending content in fashion, beauty, lifestyle, and travel

## Business & Analytics Tools

- [Pinterest Analytics](https://analytics.pinterest.com/): Pinterest Analytics dashboard for audience insights and pin performance
- [Pinterest Ads](https://ads.pinterest.com/expert/): Pinterest Ads expert program for advertising consultation and support

## Developer Resources

- [Pinterest Developers](https://developers.pinterest.com/): Pinterest API platform for developers with shopping and conversion APIs

## Creator Resources

- [Pinterest Create](https://create.pinterest.com/get-started/): Creator Hub guide for setting up accounts and creating content

## Getting Started

- [Get a Pinterest account | Pinterest help](https://help.pinterest.com/en/article/get-a-pinterest-account): Help guide for creating and setting up a Pinterest account

## Optional

- [Home Account (home_account) - Profile | Pinterest](https://ca.pinterest.com/home_account/): User profile page for home_account showing boards and pins collection
